description: APPLICATION FOR THE PROPOSED CHANGE OF USE FROM A HMO (CLASS C4) TO A 7 PERSON HMO (SUI GENERIS)
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The development would result in the loss of a family sized unit, thereby failing to comply with policy H11.1 of Merton Local Plan 2024.

Reason : 2 - The use of the outbuilding as a self-contained dwelling unit (C3 Use) for 1 person occupancy, by reason of unsatisfactory layout, floor to ceiling height and floor area, the scheme represents over-intensification and over-development of the site that would result in sub-standard living conditions and environment, to the detriment of the amenities of future occupiers.  The development would thereby be contrary to, in particular, policy D12.3 of Merton Local Plan (2024), Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021) and the Technical Housing Standards - Nationally Described Space Standard.

Reason : 3 - The use of the main property as C4 (House in Multiple Occupation) by 6 persons, by reason of unsatisfactory layout, substandard kitchen layout and inadequate internal floor space represents over-intensification and over-development of the site that would result in sub-standard living conditions and environment, to the detriment of the amenities of future occupiers. The proposals would therefore be contrary to, in particular, policy D6 of the London Plan 2021, policies H11.1, H11.2, H11.3 and D12.3 of the Merton Local Plan 2024

Reason : 4 - By reason of absence of satisfactory refuse provision, the scheme is considered to adversely impact on the free flow of traffic in the locality to the detriment of highway and pedestrian safety and visual amenity of the locality. Therefore the proposal fails to comply with, in particular, policies SI7 and SI8 of the London Plan 2021 and D12.3 and W14.4 of the Merton Local Plan 2024.

Reason : 5 - In the absence of accessible, sufficient and satisfactory cycle parking provision, the development has failed to provide sufficient secure, integrated, convenient and accessible cycle parking facilities and thus failed to promote sustainable form of transport, contrary to, in particular, policy T5 of the London Plan 2021, and policies T16.1 and T16.2 of the Merton Local Plan 2024

Reason : 6 - In the absence of a water usage statement and an Air Quality Neutral Statement, it has not been demonstrated that the proposal would minimise water use and would be at minimum air quality neutral, not worsening local air quality. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies SI 1, SI 2, SI 5 and SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and policy P15.10 of the Merton Local Plan 2024

Reason : 7 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was not considered to comply with the provisions of the Development Plan and NPPF as submitted, and would have required substantial changes such that a new application would be required. 
"	It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.
